stem.text: Nitrogen dioxide is a gas that contributes to air pollution. It is produced in internal combustion engines.

A.text: Nitrogen dioxide acts as a catalyst in the atmospheric oxidation of sulfur dioxide to sulfur trioxide.

B.text: Nitrogen dioxide reacts to form nitrogen monoxide in the catalytic converter of a car exhaust system.

C.text: PAN forms when nitrogen dioxide reacts with the gases formed by complete combustion of the fuel.

D.text: Under high pressure in an internal combustion engine, nitrogen dioxide forms from impurities in the fuel.
